newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end up ahead of housing report.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end up ahead of housing report.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed higher on short covering ahead of Tuesday's U.S. housing starts report, traders said.

Futures started easier on light pressure from slow cash trade, but moved up during the day as the market looked ahead to the report. Expectations are for an increase in starts from the previous month, they said.

Economists estimated an average November starts at 1.39 million units, up from 1.366 million the previous month. Lower interest rates are seen boosting starts late this year and into the first quarter of next year
The housing report will be released Tuesday at 0730 CST.
Lumber closed $2.10 to $5.00 per tbf higher with January up $3.60 at $384.10 and March up $2.50 at $382.60 per tbf.
